name: MailerLite
description: MailerLite is an email marketing platform for creating campaigns, automations, landing pages, signup forms, websites, and digital products, with subscriber-based plans and a permanent free tier.
best_for: Creators, small businesses, and marketing teams that want email campaigns, automation, lead capture, and lightweight website or landing-page tools in one platform.
features: Email campaigns with drag-and-drop, simple, and custom HTML editors
Visual email automations with subscriber, ecommerce, and behavior-based triggers
Landing pages, websites, signup forms, and pop-ups for lead capture
Campaign A/B testing and comparative performance reporting
Digital products, paid newsletters, and appointment booking tools
100+ integrations plus API and MCP connectivity
Native Shopify integration syncs customers and order data, imports store products, and supports ecommerce-triggered email workflows

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: For up to 250 subscribers, with 2,500 monthly emails, 2 user seats, campaigns, up to 3 visual automations, 1 website, 1 landing page, and signup forms.

tiers.name: Comfort
tiers.notes: Starts at $12/month. Adds unlimited newsletter templates, up to 50 visual automations, 10 websites and landing pages, 10 signup forms and pop-ups, AI writing tools, smart sending, and other paid features.

tiers.name: Power
tiers.notes: Starts at $25/month. Adds unlimited monthly emails, unlimited user seats, unlimited automations, landing pages, signup forms, digital products and bookings, plus 24/7 live chat and email support.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: For businesses with more than 200,000 subscribers. Custom pricing with priority support, onboarding and training, a dedicated success manager, and deliverability support.

pros: Permanent free plan includes campaigns, automations, landing pages, a website, and signup forms
Comfort starts at $12/month and Power at $25/month for the lowest subscriber tier
Combines email marketing with lead-capture pages, forms, websites, digital products, and booking tools
Shopify connects natively so customer and order data can feed segmentation, product content, and ecommerce-triggered workflows
cons: The Free plan is capped at 250 active subscribers and 2,500 monthly emails
Comfort limits visual automations, forms, and websites/landing pages while Power removes those usage limits
Enterprise pricing is custom rather than publicly listed

faq.question: Does MailerLite have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. MailerLite's current Free plan supports up to 250 subscribers and 2,500 monthly emails, plus campaigns, limited visual automations, a website, a landing page, and signup forms.

faq.question: How much does MailerLite cost?
faq.answer: MailerLite's Comfort plan starts at $12/month and its Power plan starts at $25/month at the lowest subscriber tier. Pricing rises with subscriber count, and annual billing is discounted relative to monthly billing.

faq.question: What changed in MailerLite pricing in 2026?
faq.answer: MailerLite introduced updated pricing and plan structure in June 2026. Growing Business is now Comfort and Advanced is now Power; the Free plan also changed to a 250-subscriber and 2,500-email monthly limit.

alternatives.name: Brevo
alternatives.description: An email and CRM platform with email-volume-based pricing, SMS and WhatsApp messaging, automations, and a built-in CRM.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses that want multi-channel messaging and pricing based primarily on email volume

alternatives.name: Moosend
alternatives.description: An email marketing and automation platform with campaigns, automation workflows, landing pages, and subscriber management.
alternatives.best_for: Teams focused on email campaigns and automation with straightforward subscriber-based plans

alternatives.name: GetResponse
alternatives.description: An email marketing platform with automation, landing pages, webinars, ecommerce marketing, and lead-generation tools.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses wanting email marketing plus webinars and broader lead-generation tools
